confirmatory_association.baseline_inference: Sampling-instability association is a prespecified comparator and is reported without inclusion in the primary Holm family.
confirmatory_association.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the two primary warning predictors.
confirmatory_association.permutation: Exact permutation of source-dataset assignments within each model; 4!^3 = 13,824 blocked permutations.
confirmatory_association.support_rule: A primary association is supported only when rho > 0 and its Holm-adjusted one-sided p-value is below 0.05.

predictive_validation.comparison_rule: Positive MAE improvement means lower MAE than the prespecified model-plus-sampling-instability baseline.
predictive_validation.continuous_preprocessing: Training-fold mean and population-standard-deviation scaling only.
predictive_validation.cross_validation: Four-fold leave-one-source-dataset-out; all seeds and models from the held-out source dataset remain exclusively in the test fold.
predictive_validation.estimator: Ordinary least squares with no tuning and no clipping.
predictive_validation.known_covariate: Fixed model-identity indicators; source-dataset identity excluded.

reporting_units.confirmatory_association: Twelve source-dataset-by-model units; outcome and warning scores are arithmetic means across five seeds, and outcomes are also averaged across the three eligible target datasets.
reporting_units.predictive_validation: Sixty source-dataset-by-seed-by-model units; each outcome is the arithmetic mean across the three eligible target datasets.

scope_caution: Inference is bounded to the four evaluated NetFlow-v3 datasets and three fixed model families; it is not universal deployment validation.
secondary_analysis: Secondary outcomes and direction/model summaries are descriptive; no additional confirmatory significance claims are made.
timing: Frozen after all 180 label-blind target predictions were sealed and before any target label was joined to a prediction.
